title: CMS and claims opportunity atlas
summary: The claims-defined view of where reimbursed demand actually sits: cohort, county, CMS signal, the codes and bundles that pay, and the revenue at stake. It is the intelligence spine under Fund II, and an asset in its own right.
detail: Most healthcare market sizing is a slide. This is a query. A cohort defined out of claims, the counties where the gap is widest, the CMS metric that proves the gap, the CPT and HCPCS codes that pay for closing it, and a capture rate we are willing to defend in writing.
We count it as a portfolio work because it is the thing that decides where capital goes. Every Fund II brief is an output of it, and every venture in Fund I can query it.
